subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: After the current-main conflict is resolved, should OpenClaw accept this PR's waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror duplicates?
rationale: The code review found no concrete defect, but this PR changes which transcript rows may trigger visible A2A follow-up delivery, so maintainer intent is needed for the delivery-risk tradeoff.

options.title: Accept After Rebase

options.title: Pause For A2A Consolidation
